governance.purpose: Regimen-specific consent discussion support. It does not replace the HSE National Consent Policy, the NCCP consent process, the current NCCP regimen or clinician judgement.
governance.patient_identifiers: SACTCheck does not request or persist patient name, MRN, DOB or other direct identifiers. Complete identifiers only in the approved clinical record or on the printed form.

sources.label: HSE National Consent Policy
sources.role: Consent must be voluntary and informed, with understandable information on treatment, benefits, risks, alternatives and what may happen if treatment does not proceed.

sources.label: NCCP SACT Guidance and Related Documents
sources.role: National SACT resources including the Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapy Patient Consent Form – Medical Oncology.

sources.label: NCCP National SACT Regimens
sources.role: Current regimen-specific NCCP source remains the operational treatment source.

cytotoxic_chemotherapy.label: Generic chemotherapy consent
cytotoxic_chemotherapy.description: Common and important risks that may occur with cytotoxic chemotherapy. The exact likelihood and severity vary by regimen and patient.

risks.label: Bone-marrow suppression and infection
risks.detail: White blood cells can fall, increasing infection and neutropenic-sepsis risk. Urgent assessment may be required for fever or acute illness.

risks.label: Anaemia and fatigue
risks.detail: Red blood cells may fall and tiredness, breathlessness or reduced exercise tolerance can occur.

risks.label: Low platelets and bleeding
risks.detail: Platelet counts can fall, increasing bruising or bleeding risk.

risks.label: Nausea and vomiting
risks.detail: Anti-sickness medicines may be needed. Severity depends on the regimen.

risks.label: Diarrhoea or constipation
risks.detail: Bowel disturbance can occur and can occasionally become severe or cause dehydration.

risks.label: Mouth soreness / mucositis
risks.detail: Inflammation or ulceration of the mouth and gastrointestinal lining may occur.

risks.label: Hair, skin or nail changes
risks.detail: Hair loss or thinning and skin/nail changes may occur depending on the medicines used.

risks.label: Allergic or infusion reactions
risks.detail: Reactions can occur during or shortly after administration and can rarely be severe.

risks.label: Pregnancy, contraception and fertility
risks.detail: Some anti-cancer medicines can harm an unborn baby and may affect fertility. Discuss contraception and fertility preservation where relevant.

risks.label: Organ-specific toxicity
risks.detail: Individual drugs can affect nerves, heart, lungs, kidneys, liver, hearing or other organs. The agent-specific section below lists important regimen-specific risks.

immune_checkpoint_inhibitor.label: Generic immunotherapy consent
immune_checkpoint_inhibitor.description: Immune-checkpoint inhibitors can cause the immune system to inflame almost any organ. Toxicity may occur during treatment or after treatment has stopped.

risks.label: Immune-related pneumonitis
risks.detail: Inflammation of the lungs can cause new cough, breathlessness or chest symptoms and can be life-threatening.

risks.label: Immune-related diarrhoea / colitis
risks.detail: Diarrhoea or bowel inflammation can become severe and may rarely lead to perforation.

risks.label: Immune-related hepatitis
risks.detail: Liver inflammation may cause abnormal liver tests and can occasionally be severe.

risks.label: Immune-related endocrinopathies
risks.detail: Thyroid, pituitary, adrenal or pancreatic inflammation can occur. Some hormone deficiencies may require long-term replacement.

risks.label: Immune-related nephritis
risks.detail: Kidney inflammation can impair renal function and may require treatment interruption and immunosuppression.

risks.label: Immune-related skin toxicity
risks.detail: Rash and itching are common; severe blistering or mucosal reactions are rare but important.

risks.label: Infusion-related reaction
risks.detail: Infusion reactions can occur and can occasionally be severe.

risks.label: Less common serious immune toxicity
risks.detail: Neurological, cardiac, muscle, eye, blood or other organ inflammation can occur and may be life-threatening.

risks.label: Delayed and persistent immune toxicity
risks.detail: Immune-related adverse events can begin after treatment stops, and some effects—especially endocrine effects—can persist.

risks.label: Steroids / immunosuppression and treatment interruption
risks.detail: Immune toxicity may require corticosteroids or other immunosuppressive treatment, hospital care, hormone replacement, treatment delay or permanent discontinuation.

risks.label: Bleeding / gastrointestinal perforation
risks.detail: Serious bleeding or gastrointestinal perforation can occur.

risks.label: Cardiac ischaemia
risks.detail: Myocardial ischaemia or infarction can occur.

lenvatinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Hypertension
risks.detail: High blood pressure is common and can be severe.

risks.label: Proteinuria / renal dysfunction
risks.detail: Proteinuria and kidney dysfunction can occur.

risks.label: Diarrhoea
risks.detail: Diarrhoea can occur and may require treatment modification.

risks.label: Thromboembolism / bleeding
risks.detail: Serious arterial events or bleeding can occur.

pazopanib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity

risks.label: Hypertension

risks.label: Diarrhoea and gastrointestinal symptoms
risks.detail: Diarrhoea and other gastrointestinal symptoms are common.

risks.label: Bleeding / thrombotic / cardiac events
risks.detail: Serious vascular or cardiac complications can occur.

imatinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Fluid retention / oedema
risks.detail: Swelling and fluid retention can occur and is occasionally severe.

risks.label: Cytopenias
risks.detail: Low blood counts can occur.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity
risks.detail: Liver injury can occur.

lapatinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Diarrhoea
risks.detail: Diarrhoea is common and can become severe.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity
risks.detail: Serious liver injury can occur.

risks.label: Reduced heart function / QT effects
risks.detail: Cardiac dysfunction or QT prolongation can occur.

risks.label: Interstitial lung disease
risks.detail: Rare serious pulmonary toxicity can occur.

neratinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Severe diarrhoea
risks.detail: Diarrhoea is very common and can cause dehydration; prophylaxis/early treatment is important.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity
risks.detail: Liver-enzyme elevations and liver injury can occur.

tucatinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Diarrhoea
risks.detail: Diarrhoea can be severe and cause dehydration.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity
risks.detail: Liver-enzyme elevations can occur and require monitoring.

risks.label: Nausea / gastrointestinal symptoms
risks.detail: Nausea and other gastrointestinal symptoms can occur.

osimertinib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis
risks.detail: Rare serious or fatal inflammatory lung toxicity can occur.

risks.label: Cardiomyopathy / QT prolongation
risks.detail: Reduced heart function and QT prolongation can occur.

risks.label: Rash and diarrhoea
risks.detail: Skin rash and diarrhoea are common.

tamoxifen.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Venous thromboembolism
risks.detail: Deep-vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism can occur.

risks.label: Endometrial cancer / uterine pathology
risks.detail: Tamoxifen increases the risk of endometrial pathology and cancer.

risks.label: Hot flushes and menopausal symptoms
risks.detail: Hot flushes and other endocrine symptoms are common.

abiraterone.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Hypertension, low potassium and fluid retention
risks.detail: Mineralocorticoid excess can cause hypertension, hypokalaemia and oedema.

risks.label: Hepatotoxicity
risks.detail: Liver injury can occur and requires monitoring.

risks.label: Cardiac complications
risks.detail: Fluid retention, hypertension or electrolyte disturbance can worsen cardiac disease.

enzalutamide.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Fatigue, falls and fractures
risks.detail: Fatigue and falls can occur and fracture risk may be increased.

risks.label: Hypertension
risks.detail: Blood pressure can rise.

risks.label: Seizure
risks.detail: Seizures are uncommon but clinically important.

rituximab.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Infusion reaction
risks.detail: Infusion reactions are common with early doses and can rarely be severe.

risks.label: Serious infection / viral reactivation
risks.detail: B-cell depletion can increase infection risk; hepatitis B reactivation is an important risk.

risks.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
risks.detail: PML is very rare but serious.

risks.label: Cytopenias
risks.detail: Blood-count suppression can occur.

bortezomib.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Peripheral neuropathy
risks.detail: Numbness, tingling or pain can occur and may require dose modification.

risks.label: Thrombocytopenia
risks.detail: Platelet counts can fall and increase bleeding risk.

risks.label: Herpes zoster reactivation
risks.detail: Shingles/reactivation risk is increased; antiviral prophylaxis is commonly used.

risks.label: Orthostatic hypotension / autonomic effects
risks.detail: Dizziness or postural blood-pressure falls can occur.

lenalidomide.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.detail: Blood clots can occur; thromboprophylaxis may be required.

risks.label: Cytopenias
risks.detail: Neutropenia and thrombocytopenia can occur.

risks.label: Severe fetal harm / pregnancy prevention
risks.detail: Lenalidomide is highly teratogenic and requires strict pregnancy-prevention measures.

risks.label: Rash
risks.detail: Skin reactions can occur and can rarely be severe.

pomalidomide.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.detail: Blood clots can occur; thromboprophylaxis may be required.

risks.label: Cytopenias

risks.label: Severe fetal harm / pregnancy prevention
risks.detail: Pomalidomide is highly teratogenic and requires strict pregnancy-prevention measures.

risks.label: Infection
risks.detail: Serious infections can occur.

daratumumab.source_basis: Confirm against the current regimen-specific NCCP source and current medicine product information before formal clinical release.

risks.label: Infusion / injection reaction
risks.detail: Administration reactions can occur, especially with early doses.

risks.label: Infection
risks.detail: Respiratory and other infections can occur and can be serious.

risks.label: Cytopenias
risks.detail: Neutropenia and thrombocytopenia can occur.

risks.label: Interference with blood compatibility testing
risks.detail: Daratumumab can interfere with red-cell antibody screening/crossmatching; the transfusion service must be informed.

risks.label: Gastrointestinal irritation
